name: Масло вершкове 82,5%
source: Current Ukrainian manufacturer/retail references for sweet-cream butter 82.5%
audit_note: Generic-first reference for ordinary sweet-cream butter 82.5%. Carbohydrate contribution is very small; brand/package differences do not justify separate CarbCalc identities unless the product is a spread or flavoured butter.

name: Молоко згущене з цукром 8,5%
source: Current Ukrainian retail references for whole sweetened condensed milk 8.5%
audit_note: Generic-first classic whole sweetened condensed milk. High carbohydrate density is clinically relevant for CarbCalc. Separate branded identities are unnecessary for ordinary GOST/DSTU-style whole condensed milk unless label carbohydrates materially differ.

name: Молочний напій шоколадний
source: Current Ukrainian retail references for ready-to-drink chocolate milk beverages
audit_note: Representative sweet chocolate milk-drink profile. This is not a universal value: branded RTD milk drinks can differ materially in added sugar and should be split when an exact product label/EAN is available and meaningfully differs.
